Financial Brain LLC · Fresh install · Version 0.4.10

Set up your Financial Brain

This is the complete install document for both you and your assistant. Reading it changes nothing. Visiting, downloading or sharing it does not give consent to install software or change an account. Keep normal approval controls on and decide about each explained change in your own words.

Before you start

  • Set aside about 45 minutes, with extra time for missing software or account approvals. This is a planning estimate, not a measured guarantee.
  • Use macOS 13.5 or newer, or Windows 10 or newer on supported hardware, a reliable internet connection and a computer where your ordinary user can install apps.
  • Have Claude desktop installed and signed in. The current preparation also requires Node.js 22 or newer, Git, Claude Code and Codex, with the required tool accounts and sign-ins ready. Claude desktop alone is insufficient. If any prerequisite is missing, pause for support; this page does not install missing tools or promise they are bundled.
  • The owner must confirm their own Cloudflare account has Workers Paid. A paid website plan is different. Workers Paid and usage have separate charges; review current pricing and billing in the official account before agreeing. Claude or other tool subscriptions may also have their own costs.
  • Choose the Google or Microsoft account holding the records you may later connect. You must control it or have permission. Keep sign-in and two-step verification ready. Connecting records is optional and separate.
  • If a Brain or manifest already exists, stop this fresh-install path. An update or recovery needs its own reviewed plan.

What this will change

  • The signed package adds a small preparation app for the current user. Opening Run Financial Brain Machine Prep checks prerequisites, then downloads and checks the exact 0.4.10 bootstrap package described below.
  • Approved setup writes local CLI files, a manifest and bootstrap status. It can add the CLI folder to the user's PATH, install a reviewed technician skill, add assistant MCP settings and create an owner workspace instruction file. Review the exact paths and changes first.
  • Separately approved setup creates the named Worker, database, storage and search resources in the chosen Cloudflare account. Review the exact resource plan and costs first. The owner signs in and enrolls owner access and a passkey privately.
  • A public sample document is checked before any private records. Each provider connection and its scope is a separate owner choice.

What it will not touch: this fresh-install permission does not include an existing Brain, private files, bank connections, source permissions, indexed document removal, daily schedules or an existing store workflow. The assistant must stop if a proposed action exceeds the explained plan.

How to undo: reading and hash checks need no undo. Before installing, review the sealed toolkit's uninstall and rollback instructions and identify the exact new local files and cloud resources it owns. Closing a window does not undo setup. Removal is optional, off by default and requires a separate owner decision. Stop if recovery instructions are missing.

Your first step

Open financialbrain.ai/install and download the signed installer for your computer below. If this page says installs are closed, stop there. There is no separate prompt to paste into Claude.

Save the download, compare its size and SHA-256, and check its signature before opening it. The expected publisher is Financial Brain LLC. Stop on a mismatch, a blocked file, an unknown publisher or a request for administrator access. Do not bypass operating-system protections.

stat -f %z '/path/to/saved.pkg'
shasum -a 256 '/path/to/saved.pkg'
pkgutil --check-signature '/path/to/saved.pkg'
spctl --assess --type install --verbose '/path/to/saved.pkg'

Read the displayed signature and compare the values above. Open the verified package as your current user. Use the current-user Applications folder, never sudo or an administrator install. If it offers only a machine-wide install, stop. Then open Run Financial Brain Machine Prep from your Applications folder.

Inspect the saved package in that owner-opened window, replacing only the quoted path:

(Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\path\to\saved.msi').Length

Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath 'C:\path\to\saved.msi' | Format-List Status,SignerCertificate,TimeStamperCertificate

Require a Valid signature, a timestamp and the expected publisher. Before setup writes, review and use the file-location checker below in the same ordinary window. Open the verified .msi as your normal user, then Run Financial Brain Machine Prep from Start. Never use Run as administrator or disable Smart App Control.

Readable checkers and version gate

Read each complete source file before execution. Saving a script for review does not run it. Check its exact bytes and SHA-256 against this document. A matching hash identifies bytes; it does not supply approval. If source or dependencies are unavailable, unreadable or different, stop.

The Windows checker in Check mode creates one empty temporary file in LOCALAPPDATA, checks where Windows stored it and deletes it on close. It refuses packaged, administrator or unverified windows. It reads no credentials and installs nothing. Explain this probe and obtain approval first. Run only the reviewed Check mode from the saved script's folder:

& .\windows-window.ps1 -Mode Check

A PASS ordinary-window permits further review, not setup. Any STOP means pause before mutation. Do not use this page to run the checker's Run mode or invent an install plan.

After machine preparation, the read-only install-version checker reads only the intended CLI's package.json. Pass that exact, owner-confirmed file path as its sole argument to Node. It requires exactly 0.4.10; older, newer, prerelease, missing or unknown versions stop before cloud setup or assistant-setting changes. Do not infer local version from a deployed Brain, search private files, improvise flags or fall back to another release.

Approvals stay with you

The target is 1 to 3 automation approvals, not a required consent formula or a promised result. Count sign-ins, two-step verification, billing, account permissions, passkey creation and normal install dialogs separately. The assistant explains proposed changes in ordinary language and respects your actual decision. It must not dictate your answer or assume this page is consent.

Enter passwords, keys, tokens, authentication codes and passkey details only in the official sign-in or private setup window, outside assistant observation and captured logs. Do not paste them into chat or commands. If a supported private handoff is unavailable, stop.

Read the installed, reviewed toolkit and every script it would execute. Use only its supported steps for this release. Missing capabilities or any conflict with this document are reasons to stop, not to improvise a workaround.

How you know it worked

Confirm installed version 0.4.10, a successful public sample retrieval with its source, owner sign-in and a working Claude answer citing that sample. A shortcut, successful shell install or handoff-completed message alone is not completion. Record any partial result honestly.

If it stops

Pause and reply to the person who sent your card. Send only the step and sanitized status, with names, account details, private contents and links removed. If unsure, report only which step stopped. Sharing a report requires your separate approval; this page sends nothing.
